text.jp:
ところで、きみ……自分のクランに何か、
足りないものがあると思わないかい？
text.official_en:
Say! Have you felt a sense that something's missing
from your clan, but you don't know what it is?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ

text.jp:
折り入って、セオドラ陛下にお願いしたい。
ぼくをそちらのクランに加えていただけませんか。
text.official_en:
I have a favor to ask of Your Majesty. Would you
allow me to join your clan?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ

text.jp:

……なぜ必要なのかって？
text.official_en:
Well, wonder no longer! You need a playwright!
Which is to say—me!

あなたの下なら、必ずや良い取材ができると。

I have a nose for good subjects, and I must say,
you simply reek of promise!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ

text.jp:
それを説明する紙幅がもうない。
なに、共に居ればすぐにわかるさ。

It would take many pages to explain fully my value,
but in time, I'm certain you will find out!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ダンテ

text.jp:

足手纏いにはならないので、ご安心いただければ。
text.official_en:
Naturally, I will accompany you in forthcoming
battles as well! You'll see me as an asset, trust me.
